in_hebrew.name: Marjy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marjy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Maria', which means 'bitter' or 'rebellious'. The suffix 'jy' is believed to mean 'jewel'. This name was often given to girls named after the Virgin Mary.

in_greek.name: Marjy
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Mary's jewel
in_greek.long_meaning: Marjy είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name 'Maria', which means 'bitter' or 'rebellious'. The suffix 'jy' is believed to mean 'jewel'. This name was often given to girls named after the Virgin Mary.

in_latin.name: Marjy
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Mary's jewel
in_latin.long_meaning: Marjy est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name 'Maria', which means 'bitter' or 'rebellious'. The suffix 'jy' is believed to mean 'jewel'. This name was often given to girls named after the Virgin Mary.
